proposed_decisions.reason: Bound partial I/O, timeout and detach without owning child or leaving blocked workers

proposed_decisions.choice: Python package nested at packages/sdk/python; local source-copy import, no packaging/install manifest

proposed_decisions.choice: Exactly four current CVG v1 RPC methods; polling events, no remote resume/cancel/approval
proposed_decisions.reason: Source protocol has no additional methods; preserve original task remainder

proposed_decisions.choice: Task.cancel of admitted request terminates transport and translates to SdkWireError closed with outcome metadata
proposed_decisions.reason: Preserve per-request uncertainty without inventing RPC cancellation
proposed_decisions.review: PENDING; deliberate asyncio API convention difference

proposed_decisions.choice: Pinned catalog projection plus TS-verified fingerprints, explicit Python parser/size restrictions
proposed_decisions.reason: No third-party schema/canonicalization dependency or false full-parity claim
